review_candidates.description: Get to Know Us Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results. What You’ll Do We are seeking a Senior IT Analyst to provide advanced, hands-on technical support to our distributed workforce and help drive the maturity of our IT support function. This role will serve as a Tier 2/3 escalation point for complex endpoint, identity, and collaboration issues, partnering closely with Security and IT leadership to keep our employees productive and secure. You will own the resolution of higher-impact and ambiguous issues that go beyond standard help desk workflows, including deep-dive troubleshooting, pattern-spotting across tickets, and contributing to tooling, process, and documentation improvements. While this role is remote within the US, you will occasionally travel to Horizon3 offices (including Chicago) to support office technology, larger initiatives, and in-person events. By combining excellent customer support with strong technical judgment and follow-through, the Senior IT Analyst will play a critical role in maintaining a reliable, secure, and user-friendly IT environment for our employees. This role will be responsible for….. Advanced support and escalations Serve as a Tier 2/3 escalation point for complex end-user issues across MacOS/Windows endpoints, identity, and collaboration tools. Take ownership of high-impact incidents from initial triage through root-cause analysis and resolution, looping in Security, IT Engineering, or vendors as needed. Identify recurring problems and drive durable fixes (runbook updates, automation, configuration changes) rather than one-off workarounds. Endpoint, identity, and collaboration tooling Own or co-own advanced configuration and troubleshooting within endpoint management tools (e.g., Jamf, Intune, or similar) including policies, profiles, and compliance checks. Troubleshoot and support identity and access issues in platforms such as Okta/Entra (SSO, MFA, conditional access, group- or role-based access). Act as a subject matter expert for our core collaboration stack (Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom), including complex calendaring, meeting, and integration issues. Office and event support (as needed) Provide advanced remote support for office infrastructure (conference room AV, network connectivity, shared devices); travel occasionally to offices (including Chicago) for upgrades, deployments, and onsite events. Partner with local team members to validate that office users, conference rooms, and shared spaces have reliable, easy-to-use technology. Process, tooling, and documentation Help refine ticket triage, escalation paths, and SLAs in coordination with the Global Help Desk Manager and broader IT team. Create and maintain high-quality documentation: troubleshooting runbooks, how-to guides, standard operating procedures, and knowledge base articles for both end users and IT peers. Recommend and help evaluate new tools or configurations that improve support quality, signal-to-noise in alerts, or end-user experience. Onboarding, offboarding, and lifecycle Partner with IT and People teams to ensure smooth onboarding/offboarding experiences, with a focus on standardization, security, and speed. Support device lifecycle management across procurement, provisioning, refresh, and deprovisioning, including asset tracking and inventory hygiene. Partnership and communication Collaborate closely with Security and IT Engineering on device compliance, access control, and incident response as directed. Communicate clearly and empathetically with employees at all levels, setting expectations, providing status updates, and closing the loop on resolutions. Model a “learn-it-all” mindset, mentoring more junior analysts and sharing knowledge across the team. What You’ll Bring Must have substantial experience in IT support, help desk, or IT operations with clear Tier 2/3 responsibilities supporting a distributed workforce. Must have strong troubleshooting skills across MacOS and/or Windows endpoints, including OS, hardware, networking basics, and standard enterprise software. Must be able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical employees, framing issues and solutions in business-friendly language. Must be able to prioritize and manage a queue of concurrent requests, balancing quick wins with deep-dive investigations. Must demonstrate sound judgment in when to self-solve vs. escalate, and how to document and share learnings. Must be comfortable working remotely with a distributed team and occasionally traveling to Horizon3 offices (including Chicago) as business needs dictate. Minimum Education And Experience 4–6+ years of experience in IT support, help desk, or IT operations roles, with at least part of that time in a Tier 2/3 capacity. Experience supporting both in-office and remote/distributed employees at a high-growth technology company is strongly preferred. Relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA A+, Network+, ITIL Foundation, Jamf, or similar) are a plus but not required. Required Tech Stack Experience Experience using Jira or Jira Service Management (or a comparable ITSM platform) to manage and report on tickets. Comfortable managing identity and access in Okta, Entra, or similar SSO/MFA platforms. Hands-on experience with endpoint management tools such as Jamf, Intune, Kandji, or similar (policy/profile management, compliance, asset tracking). Strong user and admin-level experience with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive), Slack, and Zoom. Familiarity with common SaaS business applications and their access models (HRIS, ATS, CRM, finance tools, etc.). What Sets You Apart? Experience helping grow or mature an IT support function (implementing new tools, designing workflows, or defining SLAs). Experience in high-growth SaaS or cybersecurity companies. Demonstrated track record of creating or improving IT documentation, knowledge bases, or self-service resources. Experience supporting zero-trust security practices, device compliance, or security-focused configuration baselines. Comfort mentoring junior analysts or acting as an informal team lead on incidents or projects. Travel Required We are a fully remote company, and this job may require up to 10% travel to be successful, including occasional trips toHorizon3 locations for office work, projects, or team events. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills. Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless. review_candidates.description: HEFESTIS is a highly trusted, not-for-profit Shared Services organisation, jointly owned by member institutions across the UK University, Colleges and wider public sector. Established in 2017, HEFESTIS is under-going growth in member numbers across all it’s core services and is leading the way in demonstrating how shared services can provide qualitative and cost-effective solutions to our supported sectors. UniDesk is a core shared service operating for the administration, governance, and continual improvement of the TOPdesk platform and associated processes. We are recruiting for an exceptional individual to act as a Senior Operations Lead, focusing on ITIL- aligned service management and delivery, technical governance and process change to support our existing members and scale the service across the UK Education sector and beyond. Role Purpose & Focus The postholder will be the technical lead for a service that has the majority of Scottish Higher and Further Education establishments as members, with other members in the rest of the UK and Malta. This is a tremendous opportunity to sustain and build a sector leading service of real importance and the role offers a significant prospect for professional growth within a successful and expanding shared-service organisation. The postholder will work closely with the Hefestis CEO, the UniDesk Steering Group and senior stakeholders across member institutions, gaining experience in service strategy, customer governance, financial and commercial awareness, supplier management and the development of a national shared service. For an individual who demonstrates the required leadership capability, strategic judgement and service-management expertise, the role provides a potential development pathway towards a future Head of Service position. HEFESTIS is committed to developing internal talent and creating meaningful opportunities for increased responsibility. Unlike a traditional internal IT support or helpdesk position, this role combines senior operational leadership, enterprise ITSM platform expertise and service-management consultancy. The postholder will take responsibility for the operational integrity, configuration, ITIL process maturity and continual improvement of the UniDesk shared-service environment. Working across multiple member institutions, the postholder will help members obtain greater value from TOPdesk, lead controlled technical and process change, strengthen operational resilience and support the transition towards a more responsive continuous-deployment model. The role will work closely with the Head of Service, member representatives, technical process managers and third-party suppliers and will make a substantial contribution to the future development and growth of UniDesk. Your Priorities Will Include Lead customers engagements and be a source of knowledge and direction in handling escalated incidents. Driving end-to-end ITIL processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Request Management, rather than just basic ticket-fixing. Provide day-to-day professional and technical leadership across the UniDesk operational team, establishing clear standards, supporting knowledge transfer and reducing reliance on individual members of staff for critical service knowledge. Managing complex technical integrations (such as SSO/SAML authentication and mail flow configurations) and acting as the escalation point for external suppliers. Exploration of ITIL and SDI accreditation for the service to better enable efficient and highly effective processes for our members. Support the transition towards a controlled continuous-deployment model, developing processes that enable improvements to be delivered more frequently without compromising member environments or service stability. Administering, configuring, and optimising the core TOPdesk ITSM platform to ensure high-performance service delivery across member institutions. Work proactively with member institutions to identify opportunities to improve their use of TOPdesk functionality, standardise effective processes, increase automation and realise measurable operational benefits from participation in the shared service. Using service management frameworks and Continual Service Improvement (CSI) to elevate service quality, drive automation, and maximise customer satisfaction. Orchestrating the technical onboarding of new member institutions, including gap analysis, UAT planning, and configuration. Main Duties & Responsibilities ITIL Service Lifecycle & Process Administration Accountable for the operational governance of core ITIL practices across the shared service: Incident Management, Request Fulfilment, Problem Management, and Change Management. Oversee the triage, diagnostic depth, and resolution workflows for complex platform queries, ensuring adherence to strict service level targets. Maintain the Problem Management process, keeping the Known Error Database (KEDB) updated, analysing recurring patterns, and implementing preventative measures or workarounds. Evaluate, test, and implement Requests for Change (RFCs) to ensure operational stability and robust change control across member environments. Platform Configuration & Technical Administration Manage core platform settings, module usage, and institutional variations within TOPdesk. Identity & Access Management: Configure and troubleshoot Single Sign-On (SSO), tracing SAML data, advising on metadata/attribute release, and supporting Shibboleth, Azure, and Google authentication frameworks. Mail Flow & Integration Management: Set up and troubleshoot complex inbound/outbound mail flows, integration checks, and Azure directory imports. Assess and resolve visibility, filtering, and structural permission challenges within the ITSM tool. Supplier & Service Level Management Act as technical point of contact and escalation liaison with external software vendors and suppliers. Drive mutual value through structured supplier relationships, logging platform feedback, articulating enhancement requirements, and tracking vendor resolution performance. Monitor service delivery metrics and assist stakeholders in interpreting performance data to anticipate service risks or SLA constraints. Service Growth, Onboarding & Knowledge Management Lead the technical onboarding lifecycle for new shared service members, conducting technical assessments of existing setups and processes. Design, build, and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) plans for both internal and customer deployment. Author and curate operational processes, internal technical documentation for common incidents, and maintain the shared collaborative space for members. Who We Are Looking For (Essential Requirements) Technical ITSM Platform Experience: Strong background in administering, configuring, and optimising enterprise service management platforms (TOPdesk experience preferred). ITIL Framework Knowledge: Deep understanding of ITIL service management principles and their practical application in a managed service or shared service environment. Advanced Troubleshooting: Exceptional diagnostic capabilities with non-routine technical problems, specifically regarding identity management (SAML/SSO), mail routing, and system configurations. Process Management skills in the analysis and deployment of relevant processes that support our members. Stakeholder & Relationship Management: Credible communicator capable of engaging confidently with senior stakeholders, technical process managers, and external suppliers across diverse institutions. Organisational Resilience: Excellent planning skills with the resilience to manage shifting priorities in a dynamic, multi-tenant shared service setting. Terms Reports to the Chief Executive Officer Location is Remote/Flexible but must be based in the UK Full time, Permanent role Full-time hours are 35.625 hours per week 9.5-day fortnight working pattern as standard 30 days annual leave plus 10 fixed days per annum for the Festive and Easter break Membership of the company pension scheme (salary sacrifice scheme option) Access to the company benefits suite including cycle-to-work scheme, and gym discounts. How To Apply Applications should be made by forwarding your CV and covering letter, outlining why you would like to work for Hefestis. The closing date for applications is 1st November 2026.
